scripts.check: pnpm versions:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm check:actions-runtime && pnpm check:cli-package && pnpm check:bridge-dist && pnpm build:deploy
scripts.check:cli-package: rm -rf .tmp/cli-pack && mkdir -p .tmp/cli-pack && pnpm --filter gardener-cli-demo pack --pack-destination .tmp/cli-pack && node scripts/check-cli-package.mjs .tmp/cli-pack
scripts.build:deploy: pnpm --filter @gardener/app build && pnpm --dir apps/gardener exec wrangler deploy --dry-run --outdir ../../dist/deploy --containers-rollout none
